Born 1 August 1776, son of Johann George Winebrenner of Hanover, York County, Pennsylvania.
He married Sarah Patterson in 1807; their children George (1812) , Marie Ann (1814) and Susanna (1818) were baptised
at Emmanuel’s Reformed Church in Hanover.
He lost Sarah in February 1825, when she was 35 and their daughter Sarah Ann was 13.
Sarah Ann later married Samuel Wintrode.
He is buried beside his wife in Hanover’s Old Reformed Graveyard.
The family tree gives his death as 1840, but his stone, copied in 1903, reads 15 August 1844.
Wife of George Winebrenner of Hanover, York County, Pennsylvania, whom she married in 1807.
The register of Emmanuel’s Reformed Church in Hanover records three of their children’s baptisms,
with George and Sarah themselves standing as sponsors: George, born 25 August 1812;
Marie Ann, born 6 March 1814; and Susanna, born 18 September 1818.
Their daughter Sarah Ann, who married into the Wintrodes, was born on 2 March 1811 by the tree.
Sarah died on 6 February 1825, aged 35, and is buried in the Old Reformed Graveyard at Hanover.
